description.en: A one-plugin index source maintained by the author, so that dsh-invest-bundle can be searched for and installed from the Discover tab before the community catalog lists it.
description.zh: 由作者维护的单插件索引源，用来在插件市场的「发现」页直接搜到并安装 dsh-invest-bundle。

title.zh: 投研插件：6 个工具 + 22 个技能

description.en: DSH-native equity research: web search, page extraction, source auditing, cross-verification, a whitelisted Python rigor runner and a channel probe, plus 22 skills - 21 adapted from ai-berkshire (Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, Li Lu) and one orchestration skill.
description.zh: DSH 原生投研插件：检索、正文抓取、信源审计、跨源验证、数值严谨工具白名单与通道探测共 6 个工具，外加 22 个技能（21 个改造自 ai-berkshire 的巴菲特/芒格/段永平/李录四大师方法，1 个总控技能）。
